Existing suite passing doesn't tell us much here — was any of those tests actually exercising concurrent access to the counter, or are they all single-threaded paths that would've passed even before the lock existed?

If the race only showed up under concurrent load, I'd want a test that spins up multiple workers hitting the counter at once and asserts the final count is correct — something that would've reliably failed on the old code. Do we have that, or just the pre-existing suite going green?
